results.name: Standing Neck Mobility Circumductions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back
Circumduct the head both clockwise and anti-clockwise making sure you are working on the end range throughout the movement.

results.name: Standing Neck Extensions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Lean your head back trying to keep the front of the neck straight.
Point your chin to the ceiling.

results.name: Standing Neck Flexions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Tuck your chin in and drop your head forwards without rounding the back.

results.name: Standing Neck Rotations
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Rotate your head from side to side without rounding your shoulders.

results.name: Standing Neck Side Flexions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Lean your head to the side (bring your ear to your shoulder) without shrugging your shoulder or leaning the spine to the side.

results.name: Seated Radial Nerve Slider
steps: From the seated position bring your arm out to the side with the palm facing back.
Flex your wrist at the same time you are leaning your head towards your outstretched arm.
Bend your head away from the the outstretched arm while simultaneously extending the wrist.

results.name: Seated Radial Nerve Tensioner
steps: Bend your elbow bringing your thumb to the centre of your chest.
Extend your elbow to the side with the palm facing back, and wrist flexed
As your extending the arm, lean your head towards the opposite shoulder
Once you reach maximum tension (without pain) hold the position

results.name: Alphabet
steps: Sit on a box or bench
Keep one foot off the ground by pulling onto your knee, or by crossing one leg over the opposite knee.
Try to form the letters of the Alphabet with your foot.

results.name: Big Toe Abduction
steps: Sit on a bench with your bare foot on the ground.
Slightly raise your big toe before trying to move it towards the opposite side (abduction).
Expect he range of motion is very limited and the movement to be very difficult.
It helps a lot having your toe on a line as benchmark.

results.name: Big Toe Dorsiflexion
steps: Sit on a bench with your bare foot on the ground.
Raise your big toe as far as it can go, without moving the rest of the toes.

results.name: Standing Doming
steps: From the standing position press the big toe into the ground till you feel the inside part of your foot raise off the ground
The arch of your foot should now look more pronounced.
Do not roll your foot out to lift the inside part of your foot.

results.name: Seated Doming
steps: Sit on a bench or box. Press the big toe into the ground till you feel the inside part of your foot raise off the ground
The arch of your foot should now look more pronounced. Do not roll your foot out to lift the inside part of your foot
You should perform the exercise bare foot or with socks, but do not wear shoes.

results.name: Eversions
steps: Sit on a step or low box, preferably with a back support. Extend both legs and wrap the band around the balls of the working foot
Pass the band around the other foot as shown in the video. Hold the end of the band with the opposite arm of the working foot
The ankle should be at 90° and turned inwards (inversion) before you start the movement. Turn the ankle out, without moving the rest of the leg.

results.name: Standing Inversions Hold
steps: Stand up straight with a relatively narrow stance.
Roll your feet out and balance.
Make sure you do not roll out excessively or you are risking re-injury.

results.name: Band Seated Inversions
steps: Sit on a step or low box, preferably with a back support. Extend both legs and cross the working leg over the non working leg.
Wrap the band around the balls of the working foot. Pass the band around the other foot as shown in the video.
Hold the end of the band with the same arm as the working foot. The ankle should be at 90° and turned outwards (eversion) before you start the movement
Turn the ankle in, without moving the rest of the leg.

results.name: Single Leg Balance 2
steps: Stand upright with a braced core.
Choose the supporting leg and shift your weight on that, while lifting the other slightly off the ground.
Try to maintain your balance while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall or ground.

results.name: Single Leg Bosu Ball Balance 2
steps: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall.

results.name: Barbell Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back, squeezing your shoulder blades and raising your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the bar by straightening your legs, and take a step back.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
flex your knees and hips and sit back into the squat while lowering your body
Continue down to full depth
Return to starting position.

results.name: Machine Hip Adduction
steps: Sit in the machine with your legs apart, pads against your outer thighs. Adjust the seat and pad position comfortably.
Slowly squeeze your legs together, focusing on using your inner thigh muscles. Pause when the pads are close together.
Slowly return to the starting position, maintaining control. Avoid letting the weights slam. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

results.name: Machine Hip And Glute Adduction
steps: Stand on the platform and set the pad just over the hip of the working leg.
Place the working leg over the pad.
Press your leg inward. Aim to get the longest range of motion possible.

results.name: Cable Standing Hip Adduction
steps: Bring the cable all the way to the bottom of the stack. Use an ankle attachment.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Band Hip Adduction
steps: Attach a band to a stable anchor point, such as a door handle or post.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Barbell Banded Back Squat
steps: Loop resistance bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, push hips back, and lower until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels, extend hips and knees, and return to standing tall.

results.name: Bodyweight Butterfly Stretch
steps: Sit on your butt with your knees bent and feet touching each other.
Grab your feet and lean forward until you feel a stretch in your groin.

results.name: Cable 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Use a handle attachment on both sides of crossover. With cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab both handles and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arms hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blades up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blades depress back to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Upright Row
steps: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.

results.name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Stand tall with two dumbbells. Pull your shoulder blades up. Give a one second squeeze at the top.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Shrug
steps: Sit on a bench with dumbbells in both hands, palms facing your body, back straight.
Elevate your shoulders and hold the contracted position at the apex of the motion.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to starting position.

results.name: Elevated Pike Shoulder Shrug
steps: Use a bench or an object like a chair to elevate your feet.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.

results.name: Smith Machine Upright Row
steps: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.
lower the bar and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Shrug
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your shoulders upward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides, and lean forward.
Lift your shoulders backward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Kettlebell Upright Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

results.name: Barbell Behind The Back 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Hold barbell behind you with arms at a
degree angle with your torso.
Shrug shoulders up and slightly back toward ears, keeping elbows locked.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower under control to full stretch.

results.name: Bosu Ball Pike Shrug
steps: Place toes on Bosu, hands on the floor.
Pike hips up, shrug shoulders, engage core.

results.name: Cable Single Arm 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Use a handle attachment. With the cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab one handle and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arm hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blade up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blade depress back to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Pike Shrug
steps: Start in a plank position and raise your hips toward the ceiling.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.

results.name: Scapular Elevation
steps: From the standing or seated position straighten your back.
Pull the shoulders back but keep them relaxed.
Move shoulders towards from your ears and return to the starting, relaxed position.

results.name: Band Upright Row
steps: Stand with one or both feet on one end of a band. Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the band to chin level or slightly higher.

results.name: Ez Bar Upright Row
steps: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.

results.name: Machine Standing Calf Raises
steps: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height and place your shoulders underneath the padded lever.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the calve block, your heels extending off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Barbell Calf Raises
steps: Place the bar on your back
Start with feet flat on the ground
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Calf Raises
steps: Balance on the balls of your feet on the platform or plates, leaning forward to use the wall to assist with balance.
Lower the heels of your feet towards the ground and pause, then push through the balls of your feet like you are standing tip toe, pausing at the apex of the motion.
Repeat as necessary.

results.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.

results.name: Cable Calve Raise
steps: Use a straight bar or ez bar attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom.
Walk a few steps back.
Pull your heels straight up until you feel a contraction in your calves and then back to original position.

results.name: Band Calf Raise
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point.
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Lean back slightly. Raise your heels straight up and down

results.name: Walking Calf Raises
steps: Walk forward and push your toe into the ground
Lift you heel off the ground each step and tense your calf muscle
Repeat on each leg and walk forward slowly

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the kettlebell off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in each hand, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the bottom of the platform, your heels extending off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Jump
steps: Start with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise stay flat footed. Using your calf muscles, mimic a jumping motion but don't leave the platform.
Explode onto your toes and hold for a second.

results.name: Tip Toe Walking
steps: Point your toes into the floor.
Slowly walk forwards and backward
Keep your heels in the air as long as possible while walking.
It may be beneficial to do this last at the end of your workout.

results.name: Barbell Calf Jump
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise stay flat footed. Using your calf muscles, mimic a jumping motion but don't leave the floor.
Explode onto your tip toes and hold for a second.
Bring your heels back to the floor then initiate the next rep.

results.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
steps: Place the bar on your back
Start with feet flat on the ground
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Machine 45 Degree Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height and sit.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the calve block, your heels extended off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Machine Plate Loaded Calf Raise
steps: Sit on the machine and press your back into the back pad.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of the foot plate.
Let your heels lower until you feel a stretch in your calves, then press back up until you feel a contraction.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a dumbbell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the dumbbell off the floor. Hold onto something for balance.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Calf Raise
steps: Hold onto something for balance. Raise one foot off the ground.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Barbell Toes Up Calf Raise
steps: Begin by standing on a raised surface (such as a step or box) with the balls of your feet on the edge of the surface and your heels hanging off. Hold a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels up as high as you can.
Lower your heels back down to the starting position, allowing your calves to stretch.

results.name: Bodyweight Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Hold on to something for balance.
Hinge forward and maintain that position. Calf raise until you feel a contraction in your calfs.

results.name: Machine Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the machine to fit your height. Place your elbows on the pad, grab the handles. The vertical pad should be resting on your lower back.
Raise your heels toward the ceiling.

results.name: Cable Belt Calf Raise
steps: Put on a dip belt and attach the cable carabiner to the chain/strap.
Take a few steps back and stand tall. Raise up onto the balls of your feet and hold for a
count.

results.name: TRX Calf Raise
steps: Hold the TRX straps under your arms and the handles in your armpits.
Lean forward against the straps.
Keep your body straight and initiate the calf raise by raising your heels off the ground.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Single Arm Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the opposing foot off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Bilateral On Box
steps: Stand on the edge of a box, knees extended.
Let your weight push your heels towards the ground.
You should feel your calves being stretched.

results.name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Push Up Position
steps: Get yourself in the pushup position.
Straighten your knees and try to push one heel down towards the ground.
Cross your other leg over the top to apply extra pressure to the stretch.

results.name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Unilateral On Box
steps: Stand on the edge of a box, knees extended.
Bend one leg while allowing the weight to push the heel of your straight leg towards the ground.
You should feel your calves being stretched.

results.name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Unilateral On Wall
steps: Stand by a wall but not too close.
Place the palms on the wall and extend one leg behind you, while slightly bending the front leg.
Push the wall in order to drive the heel of the extended leg into the ground till you feel a stretch in your calf.

results.name: Landmine Calf Raise
steps: Stand facing the barbell, holding the end of the barbell close to your chest in both hands with your elbows tucked in to your sides.
Drive though the balls of your feet to raise your heels off the ground, squeezing your calves, with a focus on making sure your ankles do not turn out or in.
Lower your heels back down to the ground and repeat for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Kettlebell Goblet Calf Raise
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in a goblet position, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Cable Bar Calve Raise
steps: Use a straight bar or ez bar attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom.
Walk a few steps back.
Pull your heels straight up until you feel a contraction in your calves and then back to original position.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a box or bench, place your heels on a step or plate, and place dumbbells on your quads.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.

results.name: Seated Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a box or bench, place your heels on a step or plate.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.

results.name: Standing Tibialis Raise
steps: Step on the plate, and place barbell on your back.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Try holding at the top for a few seconds then bring your toes back down to the floor.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Tibialis Raise
steps: Place your heels on a step or plate, and hold dumbbells to your side.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Hold at the top for extra benefit. Slowly return to the starting position.

results.name: Dorsal Flexion Hold
steps: From the standing position, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.

results.name: Wall Supported Dorsal Flexion
steps: Lean against a wall, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.

results.name: Kettlebell Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell draped over your mid-foot.
Let the kettlebell pull your foot downward.
Raise your foot straight up and squeeze the front shin.

results.name: Cable Standing Leg Extension
steps: Stand upright facing away from the cable crossover with the cable set to the height of your hips. Use an ankle/wrist attachment.
Extend at the knee against the cable.

results.name: Machine Goblet Sissy Squat
steps: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.

results.name: Machine Sissy Squat
steps: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.

results.name: Smith Machine Sissy Squat
steps: Stand facing away from the machine, positioning your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart to provide a stable base, and then reach behind you to firmly grip the bar with both hands, maintaining an overhand grip.
Initiate the movement by leaning backward, allowing your upper body to incline while simultaneously bending your knees. As you descend, maintain control
drive through your quadriceps while pushing your hips forward, gradually straightening your knees. Maintain a slow, controlled pace

results.name: Barbell Landmine Sissy Squat
steps: Hold the bar in a goblet position.
Stand tall, push your knees forward until your calves touch your hamstrings.
Make sure to keep your hips extended.

results.name: Bodyweight Reverse Step Up
steps: Start with a box or bench behind you and one of your feet on the box/bench.
The balls of your feet should be planted on the box/bench.
Drive through the ball of your foot extending your knees until you're upright and standing on the box.

results.name: Cardio Forward Scissor
steps: Do a light hop and split your stance.
Land lightly on your toes, and then bring the opposing leg forward.

results.name: Cardio In And Out Forward
steps: Bring one leg forward and then the other.
Bring the original leg backwards and then the other.

results.name: Seated Hip Flexion Hold
steps: Sit on a bench without back support.
Keep an upright back and your shoulders back.
Raise one leg and maintain the position for the specified duration.

results.name: Standing Mini-Band Hip Flexion
steps: Wrap a loop band around your feet.
Drive a knee upwards till your thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Try to maintain balance and a good posture when raising the knee.

results.name: Band Straight Leg Hip Flexions
steps: Attach a band to a fixed point.
Wrap the loose end of the band around your ankle.
Face away from the attachment point.
Raise your working leg against the resistance.

results.name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 1
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back.
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

results.name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 2
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back. Raise your arm diagonally backwards
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

results.name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 3
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Back foot should be elevated (the higher the elevation the more the hip flexor/upper quad will stretch).
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back.
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

results.name: Infinity Loop Standing Hip Mobility
steps: From the standing position raise one knee till the thigh is parallel to the ground.
Bring the knee to your side without rotating the hips.
The knee drives the movement and the ankle lags slightly behind.

results.name: Standing Knee Raise Hold
steps: Stand up straight and with a good posture.
Shift your weight onto the supporting leg while driving the other knee.
Your thigh should be parallel to the ground.

results.name: Floor Incline Leg Raise
steps: Sit on the floor and lean back into your palms or on your elbows.
Raise a straight leg a few centimeters off the ground and hold the position for the specified duration.

results.name: Bodyweight Assisted Sissy Squat
steps: Stand tall holding support for balance, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lean back while bending knees, keeping body straight from knees up.
Push through toes and extend knees to return upright.

results.name: Mini Band Laying Hip Flexion
steps: Loop band around feet, lie flat on back.
Lift one leg upward, keeping knee straight.
Lower slowly and alternate sides under control.

results.name: Mini Band Single Leg Raise
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg forward with straight knee.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

results.name: Mini Band Standing Hip Flexion
steps: Loop band around feet or anchor behind you.
Lift one knee upward to hip height.
Lower slowly without leaning backward.

results.name: Machine Seated Calf Raises
steps: Get comfortable on the machine, then place your lower thighs beneath the padded lever. Place your toes and the balls of your feet onto the foot supports.
Prevent the weight from slipping forward by gripping the handles, and release the safety bar. Lower the weight until your calves are extended.
Push your heels up to lift the padded lever and hold the contracted position, then slowly lower back down to the starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sitting comfortably on a chair with your core stomach muscles engaged, place your feet on the floor.
Place the kettlebell on your legs, just above the knees and raise your heels upwards off the floor.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Start by sitting on a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand placed on each leg.
From this starting position, raise your heels as high as you can by pushing up through your toes.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Start by sitting on a bench with a barbell resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

results.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise Double
steps: Start by sitting on a bench with a barbell resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

results.name: Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise
steps: Start by sitting on a bench or box with the bar resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

results.name: Calf Raise 3A Soleus Bias Bilateral
steps: From the standing position, bend your knees till you get to a squated or semi-squated position
Maintain the squat while raising both heels off the ground
Hold the position for a split second before lowering your heels again
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heels touch the ground, repeat the movement

results.name: Calf Raise 3B Soleus Bias Unilateral
steps: From the standing position, bend your knees till you get to a squated or semi-squated position. Be close to a pole or squat rack to use for balance
Maintain the squat while shifting your weight onto the working leg and raising the other off the ground
Raise your heel off the ground
Hold the position for a split second before lowering your heel again
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heel touch the ground, repeat the movement

results.name: Soleus Stretch
steps: Stand close to a wall on a narrow, staggered stance (toes of the back leg should be at the same level as the heel of the front leg).
Keep your weight on the back leg as you bend your knees.
Hold the position for the prescribed duration.

results.name: Forward Lunges
steps: Step forward with one leg.
Lower your body until your rear knee nearly touches the ground.
Ensure you remain upright, and your front knee stay above the front foot.
Push off the floor with your front foot until you return to the starting position. Switch legs.

results.name: Barbell Curtsy Lunge
steps: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.

results.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Find a box or bench that is roughly knee height or a few inches lower. (The lower the box is the lower the mobility requirement).
You can either place your toes or the top of your foot on the box. Point your front foot forward or slightly turned outwards and break at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Aim to get your front leg to hit parallel depth (hamstring parallel with the ground) or lower.
The further forward your front foot is, the longer the Range of Motion is at your hips. The further back your front foot is, the longer the ROM at your knees.

results.name: Landmine Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar at your side with one hand.
With the leg on the same side of your body as the barbell, lunge backward and across your body at a
degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to lower your back knee gently to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Curtsy Lunge
steps: Step your left foot diagonally behind your right leg, crossing it behind your body. Bend your knees and lower your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push through your right foot to straighten your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your other leg.

results.name: Plate Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso.
Step back and across the body with the right foot, bending both legs to lower into a lunge position.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping back and across with the left foot.
Continue alternating sides for desired reps.

results.name: Landmine Squat
steps: Hold the end of the bar in a goblet position.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Reach at least parallel with the ground before pushing through your heels back to the starting position.

results.name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back and put the bar on your back. Squeezing your shoulder blades and raise your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the smith machine by straightening your legs.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Alternating Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.

results.name: Kettlebell Alternating Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold a kettlebell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.

results.name: Landmine Goblet Curtsy Lunge
steps: Start facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar in the goblet position in front of your chest with your elbows close to your sides.
Step backward and across your body with one leg at a
degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to gently lower your back knee to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back up and to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching legs.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Step your left foot behind and to the right of your right foot, crossing it behind your right leg.
Bend your knees and lower your hips down and back, as if you were about to sit in a chair.
Push through your right heel to straighten your right leg and return to the starting position.

results.name: Landmine Thruster
steps: Hold the bar with a goblet position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the goblet position before starting the next rep.

results.name: Box Jump
steps: Stand in front of a box.
*Start with a low box if this is your first time*
Sink into a quarter of half squat and then pop your hips forward.
Try to land in the middle of the box as softly as possible to minimise impact on your joints.

results.name: Depth Jump
steps: Stand on top of a box. Step off of the box and land on the floor.
Land as softly as possible. Squat as you land to minimise impact on your joints.
Go straight into another hop after you've landed. This will help you learn to absorb impact.

results.name: Seated Box Jump
steps: Setup two boxes. One to jump on and one to sit.
Go from a seated position and pop your hips forward forcefully.
Jump and land on the box softly.

results.name: Medicine Ball Ball Headlock Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding medicine ball close.
Squat down, keeping ball close to head and chest.
Stand back up, squeezing glutes. Repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Medicine Ball Clean And Press Slam
steps: Hold the medicine ball with an overhand grip.
Lift the ball explosively, clean it to shoulder height.
Press the ball overhead, then slam it to the ground.

results.name: Medicine Ball Lateral Lunge Slam
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball.
Step laterally, performing a lunge, then slam the ball.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

results.name: Medicine Ball Self Toss
steps: Toss medicine ball up, catch with both hands.
Repeat toss and catch for desired reps.

results.name: Bodyweight Alternating Curtsy Lunge
steps: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.

results.name: Barbell Thruster
steps: Hold the bar in a front rack position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the front rack position before starting the next rep.

results.name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold two dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing one dumbbell overhead.
Lower dumbbell as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead in one motion.
Lower dumbbell as you descend into next rep smoothly.

results.name: Kettlebell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold two kettlebells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing both kettlebells overhead.
Lower kettlebells as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Thruster
steps: Hold kettlebell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing kettlebell overhead in one motion.
Lower kettlebell as you descend into next rep smoothly.

results.name: Medicine Ball Thruster
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest with elbows tucked and feet shoulder-width.
Squat down until thighs are parallel, keeping chest tall.
Drive upward and press ball overhead in one smooth motion.

results.name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
steps: Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

results.name: Barbell Reverse Curl
steps: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

results.name: Dumbbell Wrist Extension
steps: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across your knees.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

results.name: Dumbbell Farmer Walk
steps: Grab a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight down.
Walk forward with a straight posture.

results.name: Cable Wrist Extension
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a
degree angle with your palm facing down. Flex and extend at the wrist.

results.name: Kettlebell Wrist Extension
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing inwards.
Flex your wrist upwards until wrists are fully extended.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Reverse Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Reverse Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Barbell Wrist Extension
steps: Grab a barbell with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

results.name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Extension
steps: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

results.name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Extension
steps: Grab two kettlebells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

results.name: Kettlebell Farmers Carry
steps: Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
Keep your shoulders blades pulled back and walk for a specified duration.

results.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Grab a straight bar with a supinated (underhand) grip.
Kneel down next to a flat bench and place your forearms on the bench with your wrists just off the bench.
Let the barbell pull down on your wrists until they are extended.
Curl the barbell until your wrists are fully flexed.
Lower in a controlled manner and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl
steps: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing outwards.
Flex your wrist towards your body until the kettlebell is level with your stomach.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
steps: Stand straight and hold the barbell behind you using a pronated grip with your hands and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slowly curl your wrists in a semi-circular motion upwards.
Hold the barbell at the apex of the motion and then slowly lower the barbell back down to starting position.

results.name: Cable Wrist Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a 90° angle with your palm facing up. Flex and extend at the wrist.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench.
Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Zottman Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench with your palms facing forward.
Flex at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps.
When you hit the top of the movement, rotate your palms and then lower the dumbbells slowly.

results.name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Grip the kettlebells with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers March
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the knee of one leg off the floor to knee height.
Bring the leg back to standing and repeat with the other leg, keeping the kettlebell on the same side.
Repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Walking Farmers March
steps: Standing straight with kettlebells, start walking towards a set point. Pulling your knee up toward the ceiling.
Make sure to keep your chest tall and shoulder blades pulled back.
Try to keep your stride distance roughly the same.

results.name: Cable Braced Wrist Curl
steps: Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm up holding handle.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in forearm flexors.
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm at the top.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Drape one arm over a bench while holding a dumbbell. Point your palm toward the ceiling.
Extend and curl your wrist against resistance.

results.name: Seated Wrist Flexor Stretch
steps: Bring one arm in front of you palm facing up, elbow straight and shoulder relaxed.
With your other hand hold onto the palm and force it into passive extension.
This will stretch your wrist flexors.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on bench, forearm resting on thigh, palm facing up holding dumbbell.
Lower wrist to stretch forearm, keeping forearm flat on thigh.
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm flexors at the top.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Reverse Curl
steps: Lay on an incline bench.
Grab a dumbbell with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your bicep touches your forearm. Try not to let your elbow flair outward.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Hold dumbbell with palm facing down and arm straight by your side.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, leading with back of hand.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping wrist stable.

results.name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
steps: Hold dumbbells at sides, palms facing forward, elbows tight to body.
Curl both dumbbells up, then rotate palms downward at the top.
Lower slowly with palms facing the floor, controlling the descent.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards, and curl.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing downward.
Curl dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping wrists stable and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly to full extension, maintaining control throughout.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with palm facing downward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, keeping wrist stable and elbow tucked.
Lower slowly to full extension while maintaining control.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Zottman Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbells at sides with palms facing forward.
Curl dumbbells up, then rotate palms downward at the top.
Lower slowly with palms down, controlling the entire descent.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Zottman Curl
steps: Sit tall holding dumbbell at your side with palm facing forward.
Curl dumbbell up, then rotate palm downward at the top.
Lower slowly with palm down, controlling the entire descent.

results.name: Ez Bar Reverse Curl
steps: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

results.name: Barbell Curl
steps: While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out.
Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a second and squeeze the biceps hard.
Slowly bring the weight back down to the starting position.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Cable Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Band Bayesian Curl
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point. Point your palms straight forward.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

results.name: Band Bayesian Reverse Curl
steps: Attach band to a low anchor point. . Point your palms toward your thighs.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

results.name: Cable High Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set to about elbow height.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling). Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Cable Bar Curl
steps: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
steps: Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Sit on a bench facing away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Hammer Bayesian Curl
steps: Stand facing away from the cables and grab two handle attachments.
Take a neutral grip, flex your elbows, and extend.

results.name: Barbell Drag Curl
steps: Grab a barbell with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

results.name: Smith Machine Drag Curl
steps: Grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

results.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Hammer Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Hammer Bayesian Curl
steps: Stand facing away from high cable, hold handle with palm facing inward.
Step forward to create tension and let arm extend fully behind you.
Curl handle toward shoulder, keeping palm neutral, then lower slowly.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Hammer Rolling Curl
steps: Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
Take a neutral grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Rolling Curl
steps: Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
Take an underhand grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

results.name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
steps: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms forward and elbows tight to body.
Curl dumbbells by dragging them along torso, moving elbows behind you.
Squeeze biceps at top, then lower slowly to start position.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Curl
steps: Hold a dumbbell with an underhand grip. Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Hammer Curl
steps: Sit on incline bench holding one dumbbell with a neutral grip with arm hanging straight down.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder without moving upper arm.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full stretch.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Curl
steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, keeping elbow close to your torso.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to starting position.

results.name: Kettlebell Drag Curl
steps: Grab two kettlebells with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the kettlebells drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

results.name: Ez Bar Close Grip Curl
steps: Stand upright, hold EZ bar with narrow underhand grip, elbows pinned to sides.
Curl bar upward by flexing elbows, keep shoulders still throughout movement.
Squeeze biceps at top, pause briefly for maximum contraction.
Lower bar slowly under control until arms fully extended.

results.name: Ez Bar Curl
steps: Stand tall, hold EZ bar with shoulder-width underhand grip.
Curl bar upward, keeping elbows tucked and torso stable.
Pause and squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until arms fully extended.

results.name: Ez Bar Drag Curl
steps: Grab an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

results.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Cable Curl
steps: Stand between low cables
Curl one side by bringing your lower arm across your body. Make sure to keep your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your elbows.

results.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at preacher bench, hold dumbbells in each hand with arm extended, palm facing up.
Curl dumbbells towards shoulder, keeping upper arm stationary and elbows in.
Lower dumbbell slowly back to start.

results.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
steps: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip (thumbs facing the ceiling).
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Preacher Curl
steps: Stand behind a bench, with your chest leaning over the edge of the bench.
With one arm resting on the bench, hold the kettlebell, bending the arm at the elbow.
Lower your arm using the bench as a guide, keeping your forearm straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Hand Plank
steps: Start in a kneeling position with your hands planted on the ground.
Pick your knees up off the ground. Hold in this position with a flat back.

results.name: Barbell Situp
steps: Hold the bar with a slightly wider than shoulder width grip. Push the bar up toward the ceiling and maintain that elbow extension.
Flex your abs and sit-up. Aim to get your torso vertical while maintaining the barbell overhead.

results.name: Crunches
steps: Lay flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground, about a foot from your lower back.
Place your fingertips on your temples with your palms facing out.
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor. Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Long Lever Plank
steps: Start in a hand plank position and walk your hands further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.

results.name: Hanging Knee Raises
steps: Grab the bar and hang, your body still and your legs straight.
Slowly draw your knees up to your chest

Once you have raised your knees as high as possible, lower your legs and repeat. Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

results.name: Laying Leg Raises
steps: Lay on your back with your arms palms down on either side.
Keep your legs together and as straight as possible.
Slowly raise your legs to a 90° angle, pause at this position, or as high as you can reach your legs, and then slowly lower your legs back down.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

results.name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
steps: Start in a plank position with your feet on a stability ball and hands on the floor.
Engage your core and tuck your knees toward your chest, rolling the ball forward carefully.
Extend your legs back to the starting position, maintaining balance and control throughout the movement.

results.name: Stability Ball Pike
steps: Place your feet on the ball and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

results.name: Elbow Plank Mountain Climber
steps: Begin in an elbow plank position with your core engaged.
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow.
Return to plank, then switch legs quickly. Repeat.

results.name: Hanging L Sit
steps: Hang from a bar with arms fully extended.
Lift legs to form an "L" shape.
Hold for allotted amount of time keeping your abs flexed.

results.name: Dumbbell Larsen Press
steps: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding dumbbells above chest.
Lower dumbbells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Larsen Press
steps: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one dumbbell above chest.
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

results.name: Kettlebell Larsen Press
steps: Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
Lower kettlebells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
steps: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one kettlebell above chest.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

results.name: Mini Band Mountain Climber
steps: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Drive one knee toward chest against resistance.
Alternate legs quickly while keeping hips stable.

results.name: Mini Band Walking Mountain Climber
steps: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Step one foot forward under torso.
Alternate steps continuously, keeping hips stable.

results.name: TRX Knee Tuck
steps: Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.

results.name: TRX Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a plank position with the TRX straps adjusted to mid-calf length. Place your feet in the TRX stirrups.
Keep your abs engaged, and bring one knee towards your chest while keeping the other leg extended behind you.
Switch legs, bringing the opposite knee towards your chest while keeping your abs engaged and your back straight.

results.name: TRX Pike
steps: Place your feet in the stirrups and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

results.name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back.
Bend knees, hands behind head.
Twist torso, touch elbow to opposite knee. Repeat.

results.name: Long Lever Forearm Plank
steps: Start in a hand plank position and walk your elbows further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.

results.name: Rower Pike
steps: Place your feet on the rower seat and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

results.name: Smith Machine Hanging Knee Tuck
steps: Put a hip thrust pad on the smith machine bar at neck height. Put both arms over the bar and pull your feet off the ground.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.

results.name: Smith Machine Reverse Crunch Hip Raise
steps: Lay flat on the ground. With your feet on the bar.
Lift your hips off the ground.

results.name: Laying Alternating Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, arms by sides, legs straight.
Lift one leg to a 45-degree angle.
Lower leg, lift opposite leg; alternate smoothly.

results.name: Laying Bent Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Raise both knees towards your chest.
Lower back down without touching the floor; repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Bodyweight Hanging Knee Tuck
steps: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Lower legs back down, maintain controlled movement.

results.name: Bodyweight Hanging L Sit
steps: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Hold that position for the specified amount of time.

results.name: Slow Tempo Mountain Climber
steps: To perform a bodyweight mountain climber, start in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Bring your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot close to your hand. Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee towards your chest.
Continue this movement, alternating legs, at a slow pace for a set amount of time or repetitions.

results.name: Alternating Bent Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, legs bent and lifted off the ground.
Lower one leg to the ground until your foot taps the ground, keep your other leg up.
Alternate sides for the prescribed amount of reps.

results.name: Frog Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind head.
Crunch up, flexing the spine and your abs.

results.name: Jumping Mountain Climber
steps: Begin in a plank position, hands under shoulders, feet together.
Jump feet forward, landing outside hands in a low squat.
Explode back to plank, repeat continuously for desired reps.

results.name: Barbell Larsen Bench Press
steps: Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
Unrack the bar then initiate the rep.
Bring the bar to your torso and tap your ribcage before pressing back to the ceiling.

results.name: Toe Tap
steps: Stand in front of a low box.
Bring one foot to the edge of the box and alternate as quickly as possible.
Only lightly tap your feet to the box.

results.name: Medicine Ball Plank
steps: Place forearms on medicine ball, extend legs.
Maintain straight body position for desired time.

results.name: Bosu Ball Toe Tap
steps: Stand on Bosu, lift one foot, tap it on the Bosu.
Alternate tapping feet while maintaining balance.
Keep the movement controlled and steady.

results.name: Bosu Ball Up And Over
steps: Stand next to Bosu, step up and over it.
Repeat, moving laterally side to side.
Keep a steady pace, engaging core muscles.

results.name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Sit in a v position.
Pull legs and torso together.
Extend back into the starting position.

results.name: Rower Knee Tuck
steps: Place your feet on the rower seat and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.

results.name: Bench Lift Off Active
steps: While seated on a bench, place your palms on the bench by your sides
Palm placement should allow room for the fingers to grip the edge of the bench
Try to lift your bodyweight off the bench by pushing the palms into the bench
Lockout your elbows and repeat or hold isometrically

results.name: Bench Lift Off Static
steps: While seated on a bench, place your palms on the bench by your sides
Palm placement should allow room for the fingers to grip the edge of the bench
Try to lift your bodyweight off the bench by pushing the palms into the bench
Lockout your elbows and hold isometrically

results.name: Leg Lowers
steps: Lie on your back. Raise your legs but bend your knees
Keep a 90° angle at hips and knees. Lower your toes to the ground without bending your knees
Make sure you maintain a flat lower back against the ground throughout the movement.

results.name: Hand Side Plank
steps: Press your hand into the ground and pick up your hip off the ground.
Open your chest and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.

results.name: Elbow Side Plank
steps: Press your elbow into the floor.
Pick your hips up off the ground and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you don't let your chest fall forward or backward.

results.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor and flex your knees and hips to a 90 degree angle.
Your feet should be hovering off the ground. (If that's too hard start with heels on the floor)
Rotate your upper spine to engage your obliques.

results.name: Kettlebell Windmill
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in one hand and extend your arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell above your head, lower the relaxed arm towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting potion, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

results.name: Cable Side Bend
steps: Set the cable at the bottom of the stack. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, grab the handle, lean away from the cable.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Kettlebell Windmill Bottom Hand
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in your bottom hand and extend the other arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell inside your thigh, lower the kettlebell towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting position, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

results.name: Smith Machine Oblique Crunch
steps: Lay on your side with your knees bent.
Hold the bar extended over you.
Lift yourself up by flexing your obliques.

results.name: Smith Machine Side Bend
steps: Stand beside the bar.
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat.

results.name: Smith Machine Side Plank Up Down
steps: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and the bar on your hip.
Place your bottom elbow on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
Your hips will do all the moving. Think, "hips up, hips down."

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers Walk
steps: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, walk for a specified distance or duration.
Stay upright and don't lean to one side.

results.name: Oblique Crunch
steps: Lie on your side, knees bent, hands behind head.
Bring your elbow towards your knees and flex your obliques.

results.name: Oblique Jackknife
steps: Lie on your side, legs straight, hand behind head.
Lift both legs and upper body simultaneously.
Squeeze obliques, then lower back down. Repeat on both sides.

results.name: Cable Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at about nipple level. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Band Pallof Press
steps: Place the band at an anchor point that is shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Start with your fingers interlocked around the band and your fists connected to your chest.
Extend at the elbows pressing the band away from your body until your elbows are fully extended.

results.name: Kettlebell Wood Chopper
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and hold the kettle bell with both hands against your hip.
Keeping your arms straight, swing the kettlebell upwards and across your body towards your shoulder, raising the kettlebell to head height rotating your hips as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Cable Pallof Press
steps: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then pull the handle back to your chest.

results.name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Two
steps: Stand upright.
Reach with both hands upwards until you can interlock your fingers.
With your hands above your head, lean back until a stretch is felt in the abdominals.

results.name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Three
steps: Stand upright.
After completing the desired amount of reps with the left arm, switch to the right arm and lean to the left.
Reach up with your left arm and then lean slowly to the right. Lean until a stretch is felt in the obliques.

results.name: Barbell Landmine Side Bend
steps: Stand straight and hold the end of the Barbell
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat.

results.name: Dumbbell Wood Chopper
steps: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Begin with the dumbbell near one of your quads.
Rotate at your upper spine to engage the obliques.
You can pivot your back foot to keep from generating too much torque at the knee.

results.name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs bent, knees together and feet raised slightly off the floor.

Starting on one side and sitting up straight with your core muscles engaged, lift the kettlebell off the floor with both hands and bring it across your body to the other side, rotating your chest towards the floor as you do so.
Tap the kettlebell lightly on the floor and bring the kettlebell back across your body to the starting position, rotating your chest towards the floor.
Repeat, keeping the legs bent and feet raised throughout the exercise.

results.name: Band Wood Chopper
steps: Anchor band at shoulder height. Stand sideways, feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend.
Grip band with both hands, arms extended.
Pull across body, rotating torso.

results.name: Bodyweight Russian Twist
steps: Hover your heels just off the ground.
Stick your chest out and maintain a flat back. Make all the movement happen at your mid and upper spine.
Point your chest to the left, then rotate at the spine until your chest is pointed right.

results.name: Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a barbell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the barbell down towards the ground.
As the barbell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the barbell on the opposite side of your body.

results.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Take a half kneeling position. Start with the dumbbell by your knee on the side of the kneeling leg.
Rotate at the upper spine, holding the dumbbell away from your body with nearly extended elbows.

results.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Start in a kneeling position with your shoulder blades pulled back.
The dumbbell should begin by one of your hips.
Rotate at the spine and bring the dumbbell from your hip, 180 degrees around your body. The dumbbell should land at eye level.

results.name: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank
steps: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and a dumbbell on your hip.
Place your bottom hand on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
From this starting position, hold the side plank position for the desired amount of time, making sure to keep your body straight and your hips level.

results.name: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank
steps: Take an elbow side plank position. Place a dumbbell on your hip.
Raise your hip up into position for the allotted amount of time.

results.name: Plate Russian Twist
steps: Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground
Engage your core muscles by pulling your belly button toward your spine.
Slowly twist your upper body to the right, keeping your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold for a second and then twist to the left, holding for another second.

results.name: Plate Standing Twist
steps: Stand with a plate extended away from your body. Elbows mostly extended.
Rotate at the upper spine while keeping your lumbar spine in a neutral position.
Do not let the plate go behind your body.

results.name: Plate Wood Chopper
steps: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Begin with the plate near one of your quads.
Rotate at your upper spine to engage the obliques.
You can pivot your back foot to keep from generating too much torque at the knee.

results.name: Dumbbell Long Lever Russian Twist
steps: Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Hold a dumbbell in both hands with your arms extended straight in front of you.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell towards the ground, then return to the center. Repeat on the left side, twisting to the left and bringing the dumbbell towards the ground.
Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions. Keep your core engaged and avoid swinging your arms to generate momentum.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your right hand on the right hip.
Hold a dumbbell with the left hand. Bend at the hips to the side.
Make sure you don't start to lean forward to try and force a longer range of motion.

results.name: TRX Forearm Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your feet resting in the TRX foot cradles.
Prop yourself up on your forearm and engage your core to maintain a straight line from your head to your feet.

results.name: TRX Oblique Crunch
steps: Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull both knees to your right elbow.
Extend your legs back to the starting position, then pull both knees to the left elbow.

results.name: Plate Reverse Lunge Twist
steps: Step back with your right foot into a lunge position, both knees bent at
degrees.
Twist your torso to the right, keeping the plate close to your chest.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

results.name: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
steps: Stand straight with the plate held at your side
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat

results.name: Landmine Kneeling Twist
steps: Kneel down facing the landmine with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, interlacing your fingers and holding it above and slightly in front of your body.

Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, twist your torso to one side, rotating your arms and the landmine along with it. Pause briefly at the end of the twist, feeling the contraction in your oblique muscles.
Slowly rotate back to the starting position, then twist to the opposite side, repeating the same motion.
Repeat both sides of the rotation for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Landmine Oblique Twist
steps: Stand facing the landmine, with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, interlacing your fingers and holding it at chest height. Position your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the floor, with your elbows slightly bent.

While keeping your core engaged, rotate your torso and the landmine to one side. Twist through your waist, using your oblique muscles to generate the movement. Pivot on the ball of your opposite foot as you rotate away from it.
Rotate back to the starting position, then perform the same movement in the opposite direction.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Landmine Russian Twist
steps: Start sitting on the ground facing the landmine attachment, holding the end of the bar in both hands slightly in front of and above your chest while holding your feet off the ground and knees bent.

Bending your elbows as little as possible and keeping your core tight and feet elevated, lower the end of the bar with control to the ground on one side of your body, then contract your obliques to return the bar to the center. Repeat on the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Cable Half Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable just over your head. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Half Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at a low position. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at nipple level. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Oblique Pushdown
steps: Set the cable just over your head. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, push the handle down until your elbow is extended. Flex your obliques until you feel a contraction.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the incline bench with your feet on the ground. Raise the dumbbells until you have straight arms.
Lower the dumbbells to your mid chest
Raise the dumbbells until you've locked your elbows.
