results.name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Flys
steps: Lay flat on the bench and place your feet on the ground.
Begin the exercise with the dumbbells held together above your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Simultaneously lower the weights to either side.
Pause when the weights are parallel to the bench, then raise your arms to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Dumbbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press
steps: Lie on the incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Fly
steps: Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

results.name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
steps: Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement. You should have an overhand grip.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

results.name: Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press
steps: Lie on an incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

results.name: Cable Incline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set fairly low.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Barbell High Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Dumbbell High Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the dumbbells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Kettlebell High Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Kettlebell Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
steps: Position the bench between
and
degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Cable Incline Fly Around
steps: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Fly arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Incline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set fairly low.
Bring the handle across your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.

results.name: Dumbbell Neutral High Incline Bench Press
steps: Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells with neutral grip at shoulders.
Press dumbbells upward until arms extend without locking elbows.
Lower slowly to shoulder level and repeat.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Incline Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, holding it at chest height.
Press handle upward and forward at a slight diagonal, keeping torso stable.
Squeeze chest at the top, then return slowly to starting position.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, palm rotated inward before lifting.
Bring arm upward and across chest in an arc, keeping elbow slightly bent.
Squeeze upper chest at the top, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.

results.name: Cable Standing Incline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
Press both handles forward and upward until your arms are extended.
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

results.name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Pull your chin back and press the weight toward the ceiling by extending at the elbow joint and flexing at the shoulder joint.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.
Return to the start position with control. Pulling your chin back to allow the bar to pass your face safely.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height with your palms forward.
Raise the dumbbells upwards and pause at the contracted position.
Lower the weights back to starting position.

results.name: Dumbbell Neutral Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

results.name: Dumbbell Neutral Overhead Press
steps: Start with both dumbbells near your shoulders in a neutral grip.
Press the dumbbells toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't arch your back as you fatigue.

results.name: Dumbbell Neutral Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on an upright bench , grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your shoulder joint, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

results.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the dumbbells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

results.name: Dumbbell Push Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Arnold Press
steps: Begin seated on an upright bench with your palms facing you.
Begin pressing toward the ceiling. As you press, rotate your palms.
As you extend your elbows fully your palms should be facing forward.

results.name: Dumbbell Thruster
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
As you press the dumbbells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Kettlebell Full Swing
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Hinge at hips, grip kettlebell, and swing it overhead.
Extend hips and knees, lock out arms at the top.

results.name: Kettlebell Push Press
steps: Start with kettlebell in rack position.
Dip at knees and hips.
Explosively push kettlebell overhead, fully extending arms.

results.name: Band Overhead Press
steps: Stand between the two anchored bands, grasp them with an overhand grip, and position the bands at shoulder level.
Brace your core and push the bands overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the bands back to shoulder level, keeping your core engaged and arms straight. Repeat for desired number of reps.

results.name: Plate Clean And Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the feet.
Bend the knees and hips to pick up the plate, keeping the back straight and core engaged.
Stand up, lock the hips and legs, and press the plate overhead with straight arms.
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
Lower the plate back behind the head to the starting position of a tricep extension.
Push the plate back up overhead, then lower it back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Plate Full Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall holding two plates at your side.
Lateral raise the plates to your side and continue until the plates are pointed at the ceiling.
Let your shoulder joint naturally rotate. At the bottom you should have a neutral or overhand grip. By the time the plates are overhead, your palms should be facing forward.

results.name: Plate Halo
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate held in front of your face with both hands, palms facing each other.
Rotate the plate around the head, keeping the arms extended and moving the plate in a circular motion.
Complete one full circle, then reverse the direction to complete another circle.

results.name: Plate Overhead Carry
steps: Start by standing upright with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a single weight plate overhead with both hands, keeping your arms extended straight above your head.
Begin walking forward, taking slow and steady steps while maintaining a straight line. Your focus should be on maintaining balance and control of the weight plate overhead.

As you walk, continue to keep your arms extended and the weight plate overhead. Try to maintain good posture and avoid leaning forward or backward, as this could result in losing control of the weight plate.
Continue walking for a set distance or for a certain amount of time, keeping your focus on proper form and technique. When finished, return to the starting position and repeat as desired.

results.name: Plate Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
steps: Brace your core and press the weight plate overhead until your arms are fully extended. Keep your shoulders down and back.
While your arms are fully extended, lower the weight behind your head to perform the extension
After completing the extension, lower the weight to your chest, and perform the overhead press. Repeat

results.name: Plate Reach
steps: Start in a standing position with a plate against your chest.
Press the plate away from your body until your elbows are extended.

results.name: Plate Squat Hold Reach
steps: Hold the plate with both hands at chest height.
Keeping your core tight and your chest up, squat down as low as you can go while keeping your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the squat position and reach the plate forward, keeping your arms straight and your back straight.
Return the plate to your chest while you hold the squat position and repeat reaching the plate in front of you

results.name: Plate Squat Reach
steps: Stand holding a weight plate at chest height with both hands.
Lower into a squat, extending the plate in front of you at chest height
As you stand back up, pull the plate back into your chest.

results.name: Plate Thruster
steps: Start with the plate at chest height. Begin a squat.
Make sure to hit parallel depth. On your way back up, use the momentum you generate with your legs to help push the plate into an overhead position.
Let the plate return to chest height before initiating the next squat.

results.name: TRX I Raise
steps: Stand facing the TRX straps and hold onto the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly raise your arms forward until they are overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.

results.name: TRX Pushup
steps: Start by setting up the TRX straps to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
Stand facing the TRX straps, grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.

results.name: TRX Y Raise
steps: Hold the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the straps are taut.
Keep both elbows mostly extended and raise both arms out and upwards.
You should make a Y shape with your arms during the back portion of the exercise.

results.name: Smith Machine Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the bar to shoulder height with your palms forward.
Raise the bar upwards and pause at the contracted position.
Lower the weight back to starting position.

results.name: Ring Standing Pushup
steps: Start by setting up the rings to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
Stand facing the rings grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.

results.name: Barbell Bradford Press
steps: Hold a barbell at shoulder height with a pronated grip.
Press the barbell over your head.
Lower it behind your head, then return to the front. Repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Barbell Full Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

results.name: Landmine Snatch
steps: Hold the end of the bar in front of you.
Pop your hips, pull your elbows up to the ceiling, and get underneath the bar.

results.name: Landmine Split Jerk
steps: Hold the bar over one shoulder. Stand with a shoulder width stance.
Dip at the hips and knees, generate some momentum and press the bar.
As you press, split your stance. Bring the leg of the working arm back and the other forward.

results.name: Medicine Ball Press Jack
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Jump, extending arms overhead.
Return to starting position. Repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Bosu Ball Front Raise
steps: Hold the bosu vertically.
Raise the bosu toward the ceiling while keeping your elbows mostly extended.

results.name: Cable Decline Single Arm Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set above shoulder height.
Bring one handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.

results.name: Barbell Behind The Neck Seated Overhead Press
steps: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Push your head foward and press the weight toward the ceiling by extending at the elbow joint and flexing at the shoulder joint.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.

results.name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press
steps: Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

results.name: Barbell Z Press
steps: Begin by sitting on the ground with your legs extended and a barbell in your hands, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, lift the barbell up from your chest and press it straight up above your head.
Lower the barbell back down to your chest.

results.name: Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine leaning forward slightly with the end of the barbell held in one hand at your shoulder with your elbow positioned beneath your wrist.

While keeping your elbow pointed forward, drive the bar directly overhead, switching hands at the top of the movement. Lower the bar back down to the other side of your body, mirroring the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.

results.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
steps: Grab two dumbbells while standing upright with the dumbbells at your side.
Raise the two dumbbells with your elbows being fully extended until the dumbbells are eye level.
Lower the weights in a controlled manner to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Cable Chest Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start in a kneeling position facing the barbell with one hand holding the end of the barbell at your shoulder with your elbow tucked beneath your wrist.
Keeping your elbow pointing forward, drive the barbell up overhead until your arm is fully extended and switch the bar to your other hand at the top of the movement.
Control the descent of the bar to your other shoulder and repeat movement for desired reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.

results.name: Landmine Lunge To Overhead Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine attachment while holding the end of the bar with one hand at your shoulder on the same side with your elbow tucked to your body underneath your wrist.

Step back with the leg on the same side that you are holding the bar on and with control lower yourself down into a lunge position while keeping your core engaged and torso tall, then drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position.
Once your feet are back in the starting position, drive the bar up overhead until your arm is fully extended, then lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeated for the desired number of reps, then switch sides.

results.name: Landmine Rotational Lift To Press
steps: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell with the end of the bar in front of your feet. Squat down and hold the end of the bar with your hand closer to the landmine attachment with your palm facing your body.

Drive your feet into the ground to start the motion. As your legs fully extend, pull the bar upwards with your hand and start to rotate your torso in towards the landmine attachment. As you do so, bring your other hand up to the bar and switch your grip. Press through the bar to extend your arm all the way upright, pivoting your back foot to allow for more trunk rotation.
Perform the movement in reverse to return to the starting position. Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start sitting on the ground facing the landmine attachment with your legs open for stability while holding the end of the bar in a neutral grip with your hand resting at your shoulder and your elbow beneath your wrist.

Leaning forward slightly, press the bar up into the air until your arm is fully extended. At the top of the movement, switch which hand is holding the end of the bar and lower the bar back down to the opposite shoulder. Perform again to return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Sit on the ground facing the landmine with your legs spread. Hold the end of the bar in one hand in front of that shoulder with your palm facing across your body.

While keeping your torso tall and your core braced, drive the bar upwards until your arm is fully extended, leaning forward slightly for full range of motion in the shoulder joint. Lower the bar back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for desired number of reps on one side, then switch sides.

results.name: Landmine Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, palm facing in, and bring it to shoulder height with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.

Press the barbell overhead by extending your arm fully, pushing the weight upward. Keep your core engaged, your back straight, and your shoulder down throughout the movement. Pause briefly at the top of the movement with your arm fully extended overhead. Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position at shoulder height with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Single Arm Push Press
steps: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, palm facing in, and bring it to shoulder height with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.

Dip your body slightly then drive up through the ground to generate momentum as your extend your arm fully upwards. Pause briefly at the top of the rep, then lower the weight back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press
steps: Stand facing the bar in a split stance with one leg forward and bent and the other back and straight. Hold the bar in the hand on the side of the leg that is back with the end of the bar at your shoulder with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.
Drive the bar upwards until your arm is fully extended. Pause briefly before lowering the end of the bar back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press
steps: Start in a standing position

results.name: Dumbbell Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start with two dumbbells just above your shoulders.
Press one dumbbell to the ceiling while keeping the other in place.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other dumbbell.

results.name: Dumbbell Neutral Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start with two dumbbells near your shoulders with a neutral grip.
Press one of the dumbbells toward the ceiling while keeping the other in position.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other.

results.name: Dumbbell Overhead Squat
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells overhead with both hands, using an overhand grip.
Begin the squat by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your core tight and the dumbbells balanced overhead.
Lower your body as far as you can while keeping the dumbbells overhead, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, making sure to keep your back straight, chest lifted, and the dumbbells stable overhead throughout the entire movement.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Arnold Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing you and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is directly above your head.
As you extend your arm, rotate your palm to face away from your body.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Neutral Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing your body and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, press the dumbbell upwards so that it is directly above your shoulder.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing forward and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

results.name: Bodyweight Pike Press
steps: Start in a plank position. Push your hips up toward the ceiling.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows
Push through your hands and return to the starting pike position.
Repeat

results.name: Forward Arm Circle
steps: Hold your arms out to your sides.
Rotate your arms forward in small circles.

results.name: Pole Overhead Squat
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold a pole overhead, using an overhand grip.
Begin the squat by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your core tight and the dumbbells balanced overhead.
Lower your body as far as you can while keeping the dumbbells overhead, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, making sure to keep your back straight, chest lifted, and the dumbbells stable overhead throughout the entire movement.

results.name: Medicine Ball Halo
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a medicine ball.
Circle the ball around your head, maintaining control.
Complete the desired number of repetitions in both directions.

results.name: Medicine Ball Overhead Reverse Lunge
steps: Hold medicine ball overhead.
Step back into lunge position.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.

results.name: Medicine Ball Squat Reach
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Squat down, reach ball to one side.
Stand up and repeat reach on other side.

results.name: Medicine Ball Wall Ball
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest, facing wall.
Squat down, then throw ball at wall.
Catch and repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

results.name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding one kettlebell with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebell to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebell are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

results.name: Kettlebell Clean And Press
steps: Start with kettlebells between legs.
Swing kettlebells up to shoulder.
Press kettlebells overhead.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean And Press
steps: Begin with the kettlebell between your legs.
Hinge at your hips, and lift to shoulder, then press overhead.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Squat, grip kettlebell, explode hips, and lift kettlebell overhead.
Lower kettlebell safely to start position.

results.name: Kettlebell Snatch (Double)
steps: Begin with a two kettlebells between your legs, hinge at hips, then swing it upwards explosively.
As they rise, lock out arm overhead, wrist straight.
Control the descent, then repeat.

results.name: Swing To Upright Row
steps: Start with a kettlebell between your legs, hinge at hips, swing it upward.
Lift kettlebell to chest level, elbows high, engaging shoulders.
Lower kettlebell back down, maintaining control. Repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Alternating Pole Rotation
steps: Start with the pole in front of you with an overhand wider than shoulder width grip.
Rotate one arm overhead and behind while keeping the other arm in front of you.
Then rotate the other arm.
Bring the original arm back to the starting position, then the other arm. Repeat.

results.name: Pole Rotation
steps: Start with the pole in front of you with an overhand wider than shoulder width grip.
Rotate both arms overhead and behind you while leaving your elbows mostly extended.

results.name: Plate Car Driver
steps: Inhale and brace your abdominals
Raise the arms vertically while keeping the elbows slightly bent
Once the arms are parallel with the floor, rotate the plate clockwise and counterclockwise.
Lower the plate back to the starting position.

results.name: Headstand
steps: Begin on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Place your forearms on the floor and interlace your fingers.
Place the crown of your head on the floor and tuck your toes under.
Walk your feet towards your head and lift your hips up.
Straighten your legs and find your balance. Hold for several breaths and then release.

results.name: Reverse Prayer
steps: Start seated or standing with your arms at your sides.
Bring your hands behind your back and interlace your fingers with your palms facing up.
Inhale and draw your shoulder blades together, lifting your chest.
Exhale and gently press your hands down towards the floor as you continue to lift your chest.

results.name: Bosu Ball Pike Pushup
steps: Place feet on Bosu, hips high, hands on the floor.
Lower the head towards the ground, then push back up.
Keep legs straight and hips elevated throughout.

results.name: Wide Legged Forward Fall
steps: Start standing at the top of your mat with your feet wide apart.
Interlace your fingers behind your back and inhale to expand your chest.
Exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands up and over your head towards the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release the hands and come back up to standing.

results.name: Vitruvian Arnold Press
steps: Stand tall with your palms facing yourself.
As you press, rotate your arms.

results.name: Vitruvian Overhead Press
steps: Hold the handle attachments with your fists to the sky and elbows toward the floor.
Press the handles to the ceiling.

results.name: Elevated Pike Press
steps: Use a bench or an object to elevate your feet.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows
Push through your hands and return to the starting pike position.
Repeat

results.name: Shoulders Stretch Variation One
steps: Reach one arm behind your body, with your elbow pointing upward behind your head.
Assist the stretch with your other hand on your elbow to engage your shoulder.
Pause for a few seconds, then repeat the stretch with your other arm.

results.name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Three
steps: Place the top of your hand into the small of your back, your arm at a
degree angle.
Hold your elbow with the other arm, and slowly pull the arm forward until you feel your shoulder engaged in the stretch. Pause at the apex of the stretch and return to the starting position.
Return to starting position, and repeat with your other arm.

results.name: Cable Overhead Press
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine. Stand upright making sure to maintain a flat back. Your starting position will have your palms facing forward.
Use both your elbows and shoulders to press the weight directly overhead.

results.name: Cardio Assault Bike
steps: Adjust seat and handlebar height for comfort and proper posture on the assault bike.
Start pedaling with even, controlled motion, maintaining your desired resistance level.
Monitor heart rate and intensity; increase or decrease resistance for an effective cardio workout.

results.name: Cardio Band Press Jacks
steps: Stand with the band looped under both feet and the other end of the band in both hands in an overhead press position.
Do a light hop and bring both feet outward while pressing the band overhead.

results.name: Cardio Criss Cross Jacks
steps: Perform a jumping jack while crossing the feet.

results.name: Cardio Jumping Jacks
steps: Stand with feet together, arms at your sides, ready to jump.
Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead.
Return to starting position with legs together and arms at your sides. Repeat.

results.name: Core Stability 1 Crosslateral Limb Raise 4Pt Position
steps: Bring yourself to the 4 point position (on all fours)
90° angles at hips and shoulder and neutral spine
Raise opposite limbs till they are parallel to the ground
Hold for a split second and bring back to starting position

results.name: Core Stability 2 Opposite Shoulder Tap 4Pt Position
steps: Bring yourself to the 4 point position (on all fours). 90° angles at hips and shoulder and neutral spine.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground supporting your weight on palms and toes.
Maintain a toe placement roughly at shoulder width (the wider the leg stance the easier the exercise - the narrower the stance the more difficult it becomes.
Tap your opposite shoulder with your fingertips.

results.name: Core Stability 4 Crosslateral Limb Raise Push Up Position
steps: Bring yourself to a strict push-up position
Maintain a toe placement roughly at shoulder width (the wider the leg stance the easier the exercise - the narrower the stance the more difficult it becomes.
Tap your opposite shoulder with your fingertips.
Do not tilt or shift your hips. Do not round or arch your back.

results.name: Core Stability 5 Crosslateral Limb Raise Into Knee Elbow Tuck Push Up Position
steps: Bring yourself to a strict push-up position
Raise opposite limbs till they are parallel to the ground
Hold for a split second and then try to bring your elbow to your opposite knee by driving both towards the centre of the body.
Spine might curve slightly but you should not shift your hips during the movement.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise
steps: Grab two dumbbells while sitting on an incline bench upright with the dumbbells at your side.
Raise the two dumbbells with your elbows being fully extended until the dumbbells are eye level.
Lower the weights in a controlled manner to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Barbell Front Raise
steps: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are around eye level.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

results.name: Band Front Raise
steps: Stand on the band with one or
feet depending on how heavy you want the band to be.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

results.name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Two
steps: Start with your arms at either side. Begin by pushing your shoulders forward and in towards your chest.
Continue the circular motion with your shoulders, pinching up towards your ears, and then extending your chest outwards while you finish the motion.
Repeat as necessary.

results.name: Kettlebell Front Raise
steps: Stand up straight with feet shoulder width apart, holding the kettlebell in front of your pelvis.
Keeping arms straight, raise the kettlebell slightly higher than head level.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Plate Front Raise
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing the thighs.
Keeping the elbows slightly bent, lift the plate up to the front of the body.
Raise the plate up until the arms are fully extended, maintaining control of the plate.
Lower the plate back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Cable Bar Front Raise
steps: Face away from the cables.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

results.name: Cable Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Decline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set above height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Rope Front Raise
steps: Face away from the cables. Use a rope attachment.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

results.name: Kettlebell Seated Overhead Press
steps: There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Sit tall and try not to arch your spine as you're pressing.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.

results.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Landmine Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Start facing the landmine on one knee with your other foot in front of you while holding the barbell in one hand at your shoulder on the same side as the knee that is on the ground.
Drive the bar upwards while keeping your elbow pointed forward until your arm holding the bar is fully extending, then control the bar as your lower it back to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, then switch sides.

results.name: Landmine Hollow Hold
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your legs extended towards the landmine attachment and your arms overhead, holding the landmine barbell with both hands while engaging your core muscles by pressing your lower back into the ground and drawing your belly button in towards your spine.
Lift your legs off the ground, keeping them together and straight, and simultaneously raise your upper body off the ground, reaching the landmine barbell away from your face.
Hold this position for the desired duration, then carefully lower the barbell to the ground.

results.name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press
steps: Start kneeling in front of the landmine, facing towards it, with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight while holding the end of the bar in both hands in front of your chest.

Push the landmine up overhead by fully extending your arms until the weight is directly over your head. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the landmine back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Landmine Lateral Raise
steps: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell, holding the end of the bar at your outer hip with your inner hand and your palm facing your body.
While keeping your core braced and your arm straight, lift the barbell diagonally up and towards the direction of the landmine attachment, then return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Landmine Overhead Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar in both hands with your palms facing each other.
Extend your arms upward, pressing the end of the bar up overhead. Pause at the top of the movement, then lower the bar with control back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Landmine Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit on the ground facing the landmine with your legs spread. Hold the end of the bar in both hands in front of your chest with your palms facing each other.

While keeping your torso tall and core brace, drive the end of the bar upward until your arms are fully extended. Lean forward slightly for full range of motion in the shoulder joints. Lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps.

results.name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
steps: Stand with both palms facing you.
Begin to press the dumbbells to the ceiling while rotating your palms.
When you reach elbow extension, your palms should be facing forward.

results.name: Cable Low Single Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arm straight out to the side.
Raise until your arm is parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Pec Fly
steps: Set the cable pin at shoulder height or just above.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Incline Press Around
steps: Set cables slightly below shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with elbow bent.
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
Squeeze chest at extension, then return handle slowly to starting position.

results.name: Band Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench with band looped behind your back.
Lower hands toward chest while keeping elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press upward and squeeze chest at the top, maintaining band tension.

results.name: Band Press Around
steps: Stand with band behind you and hold loop at chest height.
Press one arm forward and across your body in a sweeping arc.
Squeeze chest at full extension, then return slowly and switch sides.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest with arm extended.
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping torso stable and level.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
steps: Sit on high incline bench holding dumbbell at shoulder with arm bent.
Press dumbbell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with arm extended.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
steps: Sit on high incline bench holding kettlebell at shoulder height.
Press kettlebell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to start position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

results.name: Parallel Bar Dips
steps: Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at
degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

results.name: Machine Assisted Parallel Bar Dips
steps: Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Place knees on pad.
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

results.name: Box Dips
steps: Hold your body with arms locked above the equipment
Lower your body slowly while leaning forward, flare out your elbows
Raise your body above the bars until your arms are locked.

results.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Start by lying flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells at chest level with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.

results.name: Band Pushup
steps: Loop the band around your mid-back. The ends of the bands should be around your hands between your thumb and pointer finger.
This exercise can be done from the knees or the toes depending on experience level.
Begin by breaking at the elbows until your upper arm is by your side. Then extend at the elbows back into the top position.

results.name: Cable Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cables just below shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Decline Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cables above shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Bodyweight Diamond Knee Push Ups
steps: Begin in a push-up position with your hands forming a diamond shape under your chest.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Knee Push Ups
steps: Begin in a push-up position on your knees. Break at the elbow and shoulder joint.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Hands Up Push Ups
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body. Bring chest all the way to the floor and raise hands off the ground.
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Weighted Push Ups
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders. Place a plate on your back.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar with a reverse grip.
Lower the dumbbells to your lower chest.
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Dumbbell Weighted Dip
steps: Use a dip belt to attach a dumbbell to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at
degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

results.name: Machine Dips
steps: Sit on the machine and grab the handles.
Press the handles down until your elbows are nearly extended.

results.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and grab something for stability.
Press across the body going just short of extending your elbow.

results.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height with an internally rotated shoulder.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.

results.name: Cable Decline Press Around
steps: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and downward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Decline Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable above shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable just below shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.

results.name: Bodyweight Clapping Push Up
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up, clap hands.
Land softly, repeat for reps.

results.name: Bodyweight Explosive Push Up
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up.
Land softly, repeat for reps.

results.name: Weighted Knee Push Ups
steps: Begin in a push-up position on your knees. Break at the elbow and shoulder joint.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.

results.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Bench Press
steps: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar with a reverse grip.
Lower the bar to your lower chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

results.name: Leg Raised Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight, raise one leg off the ground, and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Plate Weighted Dip
steps: Use a dip belt to attach a plate to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at
degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

results.name: Stability Ball Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders. Place your feet on the stability ball.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.

results.name: Plate Pinch Grip Farmer's Carry
steps: Stand tall holding two plates in each hand with a pinch grip.
Walk for the desired distance or time.

results.name: Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift
steps: Stand facing the plate with your feet shoulder-width apart and the plate positioned between your feet.
Bend down and grasp the plate from the top edges with both hands, making sure your thumbs and fingers are evenly spaced.
Keep your back straight, chest up and core engaged, and stand up with the plate, keeping it close to your body.
Lower the plate back down to the ground, keeping control and maintaining good posture.

results.name: Kettlebell Farmers March
steps: Stand tall holding two kettlebells in each hand.
March in place for the desired amount of reps or time.

results.name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a kettlebell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the kettlebell down towards the ground.
As the kettlebell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the kettlebell on the opposite side of your body.

results.name: Barbell Suitcase Carry
steps: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart with the bar on the ground at your side.
Lift the bar to your side and walk for the allotted amount of time or distance.
Set the bar down and switch sides.

results.name: Seated Median Nerve Slider
steps: Abduct your arm at 90°, elbow straight and palm facing up.
Bend your elbow and wrist, bringing the fist close to the shoulder, while leaning the head to the opposite side.
Alternate between these positions to mobilise the median nerve.

results.name: Seated Median Nerve Tensioner
steps: Abduct your arm at 90°, elbow straight and palm facing up.
Extend your wrist (point the fingers downwards).
Tilt the head to the opposite side making sure you do not bend the elbow.
Find the position of maximum tension (without pain) and hold.

results.name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Slider
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist bringing your front of your fingertips to your temple while leaning the head towards the the arm.
Lean the head away from the arm as you extend the elbow and flex the wrist.
Alternate between positions to mobilise the ulnar nerve.

results.name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Tensioner
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist to bring the palm to face the ceiling while leaning the head towards the opposite shoulder.
Find the position of maximum tension (without pain) and hold.
To increase the stretch, press the palm against the face and try to point the elbow up.

results.name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Balance
steps: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball.

results.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 1
steps: Stand side ways to a pulley (you can also attach a theraband to a fixed point instead).
Hold the grip (or band) with the arm away from the pulley. Bring that arm by your side and bend it at 90°
Externally rotate the palm against the resistance. Your elbow should remain by your ribs throughout the movement

results.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 2
steps: Stand on one end of a theraband with one foot and hold the loose end with your opposite hand.
Bring your elbow forward by 45° (at shouder) but maintain a 90° angle at elbow
Externally rotate against the resistance.

results.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 3
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° (raise your arm to the side).
Keep a 90° angle at elbow, forearm parallel to the ground.
Externally rotate against resistance.

results.name: Rotator Cuff Mobilisation Lacrosse Ball
steps: Lie on the floor and place a massage ball under your rotator cuff.
Support your elbow with your opposite arm.
Roll into the ball to increase pressure and away from it to reduce.

results.name: Seated Shoulder Abduction
steps: Stand or sit with your arm by your side, palm facing forward.
Reach your hand out to the side and over your head without bending the elbow
The thumb leads the movement.

results.name: Dumbbell Service Exercise
steps: Stand up straight and hold a dumbbell in one arm. Perform a bicep curl across your body
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder and rotate palm and elbow out.
Point the elbow towards the ceiling while the dumbbell remains just over the shoulder.
Extend your elbow to raise the dumbbell over your head. Start lowering your arm to your side as you turn the palm to face down

results.name: Side Lying External Rotator Cuff Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with the under arm outstretched in front of you.
Pull your shoulder back to stabilise the scapula.
Bend your elbow at 90° or more.
Use your top arm to press the palm of the under arm out.

results.name: Standing Shoulder Abduction
steps: Stand up straight holding a dowel. The stretching arms palm should face forward
Push the dowel to the side with the opposite arm.
This in turn will raise the stretching arm over the head.

results.name: Shoulder Abduction Stretch
steps: Stand sideways to a wall.
Raise the arm that is on the side of the wall and place the blade of the palm against the wall.
Slide your arm up over your head and step in towards the wall to increase the stretch.

results.name: Pushup Position Shoulder Clock
steps: Wrap a loop band around your wrists and get yourself in a pushup position.
Support your body on one arm, while the other moves out taping the hour positions of the clock.
If you're moving your right arm it should be taping 12, 1, ..., 6.
If you're moving your left arm it should be taping 12, 11, ..., 6.

results.name: Band Shoulder Y Raise
steps: Hold one end of a band with your arm to the side and behind your body.
Hold the other end in front of your body (overhand grip).
Move your arm away from your body and upward while externally rotating your shoulder.
Finish with your arm over your head and thumb up

results.name: Shoulder External Internal Rotation
steps: Externally and internally rotate the shoulder to mobilise the joint on the specific movement.

results.name: Shoulder External Rotation Deceleration
steps: Lie on a bench facing down.
Bring your arm parallel to the ground and bent at the elbow, while holding a weighted ball.
Externally rotate your shoulder letting go of the ball.
Grab the ball before it falls to the ground.

results.name: Dumbbell Pullover Eccentrics
steps: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell over your shoulder, straight arm.
Slowly lower your arm towards the ground (overhead position).
Pause in the stretched position.
Bend your elbow to return to the starting position.

results.name: Standing Shoulder Flexion Mobility
steps: From the standing position grab the dowel with one arm, thumb on top, in front of the centre of your body.
Grab the dowel with your other arm to the side and behind your body.
The arm that is back, guides the other in front of you and into the overhead position.

results.name: Shoulder Flexion Wall Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall.
Raise your arm above the head and place it on the wall, thumb facing back.
Slide the arm up and lean into the wall to increase the stretch.

results.name: Kettlebell Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm.
The goal is to maintain the position of the kettlebell without it falling over.

results.name: Kettlebell Walking Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm. Walk around holding the kettlebell in that position.
The goal is to maintain the position of the kettlebell without it falling over.

results.name: Kettlebell Kneel To Stand Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm.
Try to kneel and then stand up without allowing the kettlebell to fall over.

results.name: Shoulder Girdle Stability Circles
steps: Stand facing a wall. Pin a gym ball between your palm and the wall (elbow straight).
Push your arm into the ball without leaning into it.
While applying pressure, form the sign of the cross (up/down/left/right) and circles.

results.name: Side Shoulder Girdle Stability Circles
steps: Stand sideways to a wall. Pin a gym ball between your palm and the wall (elbow straight).
Push your arm into the ball without leaning into it.
While applying pressure, form the sign of the cross (up/down/left/right) and circles.

results.name: Serratus Activation Plank
steps: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

results.name: Bosu Serratus Activation Plank
steps: Support your weight with your forearms on the bosu and toes on the floor (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

results.name: Bosu Serratus Activation Active Plank
steps: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

results.name: Serratus Activation Cross Punch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell over your shoulder with a straight arm.
Form the sign of the cross adding a protraction (punch) on every end of the cross, including the middle position.

results.name: Shoulder Flexion Thoracic Extensions
steps: Place a tube roller or half tube on the ground parallel to your body.
Lie on the tube making sure your whole back and neck are supported.
Knees bent and on the ground, lower back flat on the tube and chin tucked in.
Bring your arms by you hips and pull shoulders back.
This is your starting position. Raise arms and drop them back towards the ground over your head

results.name: Thoracic Flexion And Extensions
steps: Bring yourself on all 4's. Push the ground away from you, rounding back and shoulders as much as possible.
To enhance the spine flexion suck the belly button in and tuck the tailbone (coccyx) under. Hold this position for a brief moment
Now do the exact opposite, try to bend the spine backwards. Go back and forth on these positions

results.name: Wall Angels
steps: Stand against a wall with your back flat, arms at 90° by your sides.
Slowly raise arms overhead, keeping elbows and wrists in contact with the wall.
Lower arms back down to starting position, maintaining constant wall contact throughout.

results.name: Ankle Circle
steps: Sit or stand, lift one foot slightly off the ground.
Rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Complete the allotted amount of reps, then switch directions and repeat on the other foot.
